shortDescription: Module for setup of PoolGroup Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: cloud_config_cksum
options.description: Checksum of cloud configuration for poolgroup. Internally set by cloud connector. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: cloud_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type cloud. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: created_by
options.description: Name of the user who created the object. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: deactivate_primary_pool_on_down
options.description: Deactivate primary pool for selection when down until it is activated by user via clear poolgroup command. Field introduced in 20.1.7, 21.1.2, 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: deployment_policy_ref
options.description: When setup autoscale manager will automatically promote new pools into production when deployment goals are met. It is a reference to an object of type poolgroupdeploymentpolicy. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of pool group. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: fail_action
options.description: Enable an action - close connection, http redirect, or local http response - when a pool group failure happens. By default, a connection will be closed, in case the pool group experiences a failure. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: implicit_priority_labels
options.description: Whether an implicit set of priority labels is generated. Field introduced in 17.1.9,17.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: members
options.description: List of pool group members object of type poolgroupmember. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: min_servers
options.description: The minimum number of servers to distribute traffic to. Allowed values are 1-65535. Special values are 0 - disable. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 0), basic (allowed values- 0) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the pool group. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: priority_labels_ref
options.description: Uuid of the priority labels. If not provided, pool group member priority label will be interpreted as a number with a larger number considered higher priority. It is a reference to an object of type prioritylabels. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: service_metadata
options.description: Metadata pertaining to the service provided by this poolgroup. In openshift/kubernetes environments, app metadata info is stored. Any user input to this field will be overwritten by avi vantage. Field introduced in 17.2.14,18.1.5,18.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the pool group. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
